headline: Regis loses at Cal State LA
dek: The RMAC's last remaining side closed its schedule with a fourth defeat, finishing on thirteen wins and four draws after an unbeaten stretch dating to October. Cal State LA had also beaten Regis in September, and no other conference program has a match left on the calendar.
displaced_by: Regis's defeat at Cal State LA closed the final match on the RMAC schedule.
